# Your 90-Day Personal Development Plan

I've designed a comprehensive plan that balances your three goals...

## Weekly Time Allocation
- **ML Learning**: 5 hours (online courses + hands-on practice)
- **Fitness**: 4 hours (3x strength training, 1x cardio)
- **Side Project**: 6 hours (development sprints)
- **Planning & Review**: 1 hour

## Month 1: Foundation
- Start Python for ML course
- Establish gym routine
- Complete side project architecture

## Month 2: Building
- Supervised learning algorithms
- Increase training intensity
- Develop core features

## Month 3: Integration
- Neural networks intro
- Maintain fitness momentum
- Launch MVP

## Success Metrics
✓ Complete 2 ML courses
✓ Hit fitness target (specific to your goal)
✓ Live MVP with 10 users

I recommend starting this Monday. Should I help you set up weekly reminders and create specific milestones?
